name: Volunteer at Three Square
what_you_do: Volunteers help the food bank fight hunger.
who_can_apply: Ages 10 and up. Kids 10 to 15 must have a parent or guardian with them the whole time. Teens 16 and 17 may come alone with a signed waiver.
duration: Sessions you book on the volunteer calendar
deadline_text: No deadline. Book a session on the volunteer calendar.
how_to_apply: Fill out the individual application to make an account. Then pick a session on the volunteer calendar. Ages 16 and 17 bring a signed waiver to every session.
notes: Wear closed toe shoes and knee length shorts or pants. Groups should book 4 to 8 weeks ahead. Volunteer office: 702-644-3663 ext. 349.
